title: msk-pipe: automatic generation of Muscle Wrapping inputs from CT and MRI
description: Pipeline from CT or MRI (NIfTI) to the input of Muscle Wrapping 2.x: segmentation (TotalSegmentator, MuscleMap), label map, surface meshes, skeletal model (pystaple, a Python port of STAPLE), attachment areas and export. Windows release with GUI and CLI.
